display.purpose: Large homepage hero headings; licensed self-hosted 400 and 600 faces are present.

headline.purpose: Shared inner-page, article, and tool page H1 scale.

body.purpose: Configured business-site body stack; no self-hosted DM Sans font file is present.

motion.name: button-color
motion.purpose: Primary and secondary business button color transition.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Reduce transitions and disable smooth scrolling when requested.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square, dark-filled business action that clears its fill on hover.
components.html: <button class="ds-button" type="button">Get a free site review</button>
components.css: .ds-button { min-height: 3.25rem; padding: .75rem 1.3rem; border: 1px solid var(--business-accent); border-radius: 0; background: var(--business-accent); color: var(--business-bg); font: 600 .9rem/1.4 var(--business-body); transition: background-color .2s ease, color .2s ease; } .ds-button:hover { background: transparent; color: var(--business-fg); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--business-accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent, outlined secondary action that inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3.25rem; padding: .75rem 1.3rem; border: 1px solid var(--business-accent); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--business-fg); font: 600 .9rem/1.4 var(--business-body); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color .2s ease, color .2s ease; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--business-fg); color: var(--business-bg); } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--business-accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Transparent square field with a mixed-foreground border and visible focus.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: .45rem; color: var(--business-fg); font: 600 .9rem/1.4 var(--business-body); } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 3rem; padding: .75rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--business-fg), transparent 55%); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--business-fg); font: 400 1rem/1.65 var(--business-body); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--business-accent); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--business-muted); opacity: 1; }

components.name: Current Navigation Link
components.description: Text navigation with a fine underline for the current page.
components.css: .ds-nav a { color: var(--business-fg); font: 400 .88rem/1.65 var(--business-body); text-underline-offset: .2em; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: var(--business-muted); } .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { text-decoration-color: var(--business-accent); text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: .45rem; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--business-accent); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Article Contents Panel
components.description: Square, transparent contents panel with fine border and comfortable link targets.
components.html: On this pageOverview
components.css: .ds-toc { display: grid; gap: .5rem; padding: 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--business-rule); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; box-shadow: none; color: var(--business-fg); font: 400 1rem/1.65 var(--business-body); } .ds-toc a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; color: inherit; text-underline-offset: .2em; } .ds-toc a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--business-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }

narrative.overview:
ARK keeps its understated black, paper, and gray identity. Typography, open space, and fine rules organize service information. Montserrat Alternates supplies the heading character; the body stack is configured as DM Sans with a sans-serif fallback. The source includes licensed self-hosted Montserrat Alternates Regular and SemiBold files; it does not include a self-hosted DM Sans file.

The design serves direct service discovery and contact. Responsive navigation and content layouts keep the site usable on narrow screens, with visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
keyCharacteristics: Paper, near-black, and readable gray from the existing business configuration.
Montserrat Alternates headings and a configured DM Sans/sans-serif body stack.
Open spacing, fine rules, square controls, and centered article reading width.
Client quotes and portraits appear only with their respective approval flags.
dos: Do keep business colors and fonts tied to the business configuration.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use the configured direct email and phone fallback while inquiry delivery is disabled.
Do show client quotes and portraits only with their respective approvals.
donts: Don't invent client proof, ratings, prices, credentials, or portfolio photography.
Don't promise rankings, traffic, leads, or delivery timelines without approved evidence.
Don't send names, email addresses, or message contents to analytics.
Don't show inquiry success until storage and message delivery are working.
